rows.name: Goblin Spearhand
rows.notes: Spear and saucepan identify the role; the body remains an orc proxy and the hat is simple.

rows.name: Wererat
rows.notes: Rat muzzle, ears, whiskers, teeth and weighted tail replace the human head; clothing reads as a thief. Fur and proportions remain stylized.

rows.name: Clay Helper
rows.notes: Grounded clay humanoid with broad hands, a face and maker seal replaces the winged body. Smooth segmented forms still need surface and silhouette refinement.

rows.name: Air Elemental
rows.notes: Hollow animated vortex, translucent ribbons and orbiting leaves replace the skull ghost. The swirl remains visibly ribbon-like rather than volumetric cloud.
